# make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag { #mofography.visualize.make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag }

```python
visualize.make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag(rag)
```

The function `make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag` generates a plotly figure displaying pore
size distribution and cumulative distribution from a given RAG.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rag    |        | The function `make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag` takes a RAG (Region Adjacency Graph) object as input and creates a plotly figure showing the Pore Size Distribution (PDF) and Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) based on the data stored in the RAG object | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The function `make_pore_size_distribution_fig_from_rag` returns a Plotly figure object that contains a plot of the Pore Size Distribution (PDF) and Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) based on the input Reservoir Analog Graph (RAG) data. |
